text:
Priya: FYI I saw the invoice-preview dashboard spike for a few customers after the route-rewrite release. Not sure if it's real or preview-only.
Luca: can you attach the preview vs final diff for one tenant?
Priya: pasted tiny excerpt:
```
preview: tenant=zephyr tokens_route=fast=1200 slow=0 total=1200
final:   tenant=zephyr tokens_route=fast=800 slow=400 total=1200
```
preview shows all tokens on fast route; final splits fast/slow. That mismatch is causing confusing preview alerts.
Dylan: sounds like the preview pipeline applies the route aliasing rules too early (pre-routing-rewrite) and then a subsequent rewrite reassigns events to a slow route in finalizer. So preview is optimistic.
Marta: product: customers use preview to triage costs. Preview being optimistic is bad. We need parity or clear UX labeling.
Luca: root cause hypothesis: preview uses the route resolver v1 (stale cache), finalizer uses v2 which respects tenant-level route policies (rate-limited throttles that push to slow route).
Priya: evidence: trace ids for tokens 0-799 show resolver=v1, tokens 800-1199 resolver=v2.
Dylan: quick fixes: 1) make preview pipeline call the same resolver codepath as final (blocking, more latency), or 2) tag preview with "optimistic" and surface expected delta in UI.
Marta: must avoid changing billing semantics. Option 1 is safer for signal parity but might increase preview latency beyond our SLA. Option 2 is less intrusive but defers correctness to the user.
Luca: operational intermediate: add telemetry metric route_resolver_version{preview,v2} and surface diff in console. Also add per-tenant "expected-preview-delta" in the preview UI computed by sampling.
Priya: implementation note: we can sample 1% of requests and run resolver v2 in shadow for preview to estimate delta without blocking. That keeps latency low and gives a rolling estimate.
Dylan: good. For short-term noise reduction: update alert thresholds to ignore preview spikes if sample-estimate < 1% or if unresolved-resolver mismatch flag=true.
Marta: timeline: shadow-sampling patch -> canary -> enable preview UI estimate -> disable noisy alerts. Also update docs and add a console tooltip explaining "preview may be optimistic until resolver caches sync".
ops-bot: Created issue BILL-3304: preview/final route resolver mismatch; severity=P3; linked to infra/route-resolver.
Priya: who wants the shadow-sampling PR? I can start it but will need help wiring metrics into console.
Luca: I'll own metrics + alert tweaks. Dylan can do resolver wiring. Priya please add a short playbook for customers hitting surprise deltas.
Marta: add product copy: "Preview shows estimated costs and may differ from final invoice when routing policies change. We provide a preview-confidence score."
Dylan: small snippet of pseudo-impl for sampling (shadow):
```
if (rand() < 0.01) {
  res_v2 = resolve_route_v2(event)
  emit_metric("preview.shadow_v2_diff", compare(res_v1, res_v2))
}
```
Luca: metric names: "preview.shadow_v2_diff_count", "preview.shadow_v2_token_delta". Put them on per-tenant dashboards.
Priya: cool. I'll create the runbook and draft the UI tooltip. Let's keep customers informed on the public status page.
Marta: thanks, team. Keep billing.steering looped.
ops-bot: Note: added slack-reminder in 24h to check canary stats.
